scope: Exact SM-S948B Diagnostic/Mobile phone screenshot and native-state comparison; not performance or visual acceptance

control.initial19AstcStartupLog: unavailable; not inferred from the separate repair startup

candidateActualModuleInspection.diagnosticAtomicsAndBinding22: observed, not treated as failures; this is Diagnostic/Mobile

comparisonMethod.imageComparison: unchanged image_comparison; max RGB difference <=3 and fraction of pixels with max channel difference >1 <=0.001; no crop

overallComparison.interpretation: Any false component is a comparison failure or unresolved mismatch; no performance or quality admission follows from a pass.

limitations: The normal control is explicitly composite: 19 retained initial captures plus one separate successful repair capture; no synthetic complete control manifest was generated.
The initial 19 capture run has no retained startup ASTC log; ASTC selection is proven by the same exact APK in the separate repair run only.
The original-19 run failed before emitting its final manifest, so those rows have computed file hashes and native state checks but no successful per-row UI-suppression manifest claim.
Counters and resource inventories are reported as observed; equality does not prove phase-4 closure or hardware-counter coverage.
PNG screenshots are not raw internal storage images; no performance, sustained-FPS, or release-quality conclusion is made.
Geometry identity is checked through the native player render route, TLAS ownership, checkpoint state, and later package/source receipts; no per-capture mesh byte readback is implied.
